correctness.rationale: Original UPHCT likelihood from pinned RESULT and 2026 AIMS primary paper checked directly. Set δ=1/γ; all δ powers cancel, yielding L(δ)=(1+δ)^ν(1+δs*)^(−R*) Π(1+δxi)^(−2−Ri). Score D(δ)=ν/(1+δ)−R*s*/(1+δs*)−Σ(2+Ri)xi/(1+δxi). For yi∈(0,1), yi/(1+δyi)≥yi/(1+δ), so D≤(ν−T)/(1+δ), strict if T=ν with interior times. If T≥ν, likelihood strictly declines in δ>0 and has supremum only δ=0, γ=∞, uniform limit. If T<ν, D(0)>0, L(∞)=0 and D asymptotically negative, so a finite global maximum exists (uniqueness not claimed). Complete iid case T=2Σxi gives xbar<1/2, with positive boundary event probability [γ/(2γ+1)]^n. Independent score evaluations for two complete samples and one censored sample confirm signs; proof is analytic.
